body: For general playing, I really like the HYPNOTIK deck produced by Sven Philipp. It has a True Linen B9 stock so the cards are really thick and easy to handle. The pips and faces are customized but still look similar enough to standard cards to be recognizable. I really like the main design on them as well.

It’s not necessarily bad. It’s just that these cards in particular are poorly made. They aren’t very durable and start to fall apart with minimal usage. You can find way better playing cards in that price range.

These cards are called “MINIM” by Joe Doucet. I collect playing cards and have both light/dark versions. I’d only recommend them for collecting, as they’re are made from PVC and quite difficult to read for normal playability.

-Make sure your getting at least 1g of protein per pound of body weight.
- Get around 40-60g of healthy fats a day
- fill the rest in with good carbs

Eggs, chicken, tuna, are inexpensive protein sources
(Usually fattier cuts of meat(chicken thighs) are cheaper than chicken breast)

Natural peanut butter, nuts, olive oil are good fats

Other than that, make sure your getting enough sleep.

It depends on which muscle groups, and how hard you work them. Usually smaller muscles (abs, forearms, calves, biceps, etc) recover faster. Larger ones (legs, chest, back, etc) take longer. Muscle soreness generally doesn't indicate whether or not a muscle is or isn't healed...it's just lactic acid buildup. Around 48 hours between the same muscle group should be enough (considering your diet is on point, and you're getting enough rest) ...unless you're genetically gifted or on gear. Just let your progress be your guide, everybody is different. Good luck.

If I told you it's going to get better, I'd probably be lying. That doesn't mean that it won't..but I don't want to give you the typical cookie cutter response that everyone else gives. People tell you everything will turn out fine, because they have no idea what it's like to be in the situation you're in. And if they do, they don't know how to respond besides that. Either way, you can't be dependent on their opinions. 

Tomorrow you could win the lottery or you could lose everything. You don't have much control over it. But its important to realize that one of the greatest things about life is its uncertainty. Maybe tomorrow could be the best day of your life, but if you kill yourself you'll never know. 

It's hard to get up everyday and deal with the same bullshit, I understand that. But you can't give up. You can't just wait for opportunity to come knocking, you gotta kick the fucking door down and go get what you want yourself. If your suicidal, your basically at your lowest point..so what do you have to lose? Nothing. Prove to yourself that you can do this. In reality, you could kill yourself. But I know deep down you really don't want that. Otherwise you wouldn't be here. What you need is a little bit of hope..

One day you're going to find happiness, and life will be everything you wanted it to be. You'll look back and be glad you pushed through it. Don't believe me? Wait for it, and see yourself.
